# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Verdant Shrinebound**, a mobile-first portrait top-down Zelda-like fantasy adventure derived from a free-roam relic combat loop. Preserve joystick/keyboard roaming, Claim/Strike actions, chasing enemy shades, three Courage Hearts, score-on-defeat Heroic Renown, persistent Lore Index collection, and restart/menu/index screens. Rebuild presentation as a mythic overworld shrine: a green-cloaked Grove Knight explores procedural temple glades, claims rune relic tools, strikes dungeon shades, reveals hidden lore, and sees gold/green shrine motifs, readable mobile controls, catalog-backed fantasy fonts, and lightweight forest audio.

Source steering prompt: Zelda RPG adventure. A Zelda RPG adventure game with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, and a legendary fantasy tone with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game
- genre: top-down free-roam survival/collection combat game
- objective: roam a large world, claim nearby relic weapons, defeat chasing enemies for score, expand a persistent collection index, and survive with three hearts.
- input model: mobile virtual joystick plus Claim and Strike buttons; keyboard arrows/WASD plus E/K/space/J are also supported.
- core loop: spawn in center, move around the overworld, pick up tools, attack shades in a facing arc, avoid enemy contact, earn score from kills, collect dropped/random relics, and restart after heart loss reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: enemy collisions reduce hearts with brief invulnerability; zero hearts opens a game-over overlay with retry/menu actions.

## Protected Mechanics
- Free-roam movement speed/friction, world bounds, camera follow, enemy pursuit, contact damage, three-heart failure, relic cap, enemy cap, timed spawning, claim radius, strike arc/cooldown/reach/damage, score-on-kill, dropped relic chance, persistent Lore Index collection, and menu/restart flow.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/copy, procedural entity silhouettes, background and shrine motifs, particles, colors, typography, button styling, collection item naming, audio mapping, and mobile UI polish are safe to transform because they do not alter gameplay rules.
